name: samegrade
description: This kit records how [explosion/spacy-llm](https://github.com/explosion/spacy-llm) behaves on the models it uses today, before they shut down on **Oct 23, 2026**. Those models are `gpt-4` (→ `gpt-4-0613`) and `gpt-3.5-turbo` (→ `gpt-3.5-turbo-0125`). After that date, these outputs can't be regenerated.
